notes:
Snapshot: Stratosphere is a regulated electronic-exchange provider — latency and deterministic throughput are top-tier requirements. They're evaluating Redwood Dedicated + Private for a production rollout that must span NA and EU with controlled failover.

Key business drivers:
- Real-time trading-assist chat + reranking for pricing signals (sub-100ms p95 target for lightweight ops, p99 < 250ms for complex reranks)
- High availability: multi-region with automatic regional failover and <5min RTO for critical routes
- Predictable unit costs for regulatory reporting and capacity planning

Reserved GPU pool planning (customer asks / POC assumptions):
- Primary pools: NA (3 AZs): reserve 48 A100-equivalent GPUs across 3 AZs (16/az) to serve peak trading windows; EU (2 AZs): reserve 24 GPUs (12/az) as mirrored capacity.
- Failover headroom: request 25% cross-region burst headroom to absorb NA->EU failover for short incidents; want automatic warm-standby scaling to avoid cold-start hit.
- Throughput guarantee ask: sustain 1,200 concurrent chat connections (avg req 200 tokens) with 95th p50 token latency <40ms on dedicated quantized model; Redwood to provide per-AZ throughput profiles.
- Routing policy: regional-first routing with automatic fallback to EU pool; insist on KV cache mirroring or servable prefix caching to avoid cold KV penalty on failover.

SLA & negotiation points:
- Target SLA: 99.95% regional uptime for dedicated pools; credits tied to p95 response time breaches as well as availability.
- Request explicit documented RTO for region failover and proof points from scale tests.
- Billing: prefer flat monthly reserved capacity for base + burst credits for cross-region spill; negotiating ARR term length for preferred pricing.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must provide SOC2 Type II report, ISO27001 cert; KMS integration required (customer-managed keys desirable).
- Data residency: EU customer data must remain in EU pools; trade logs retained per 7 years — retention controls needed.

Quotes / customer language:
- "We cannot afford opaque failover behavior — need deterministic routing and observable cache warmups" — CTO (excerpt).
- SE ask: "Show us runbook for AZ/native failover and verify KV mirroring latency impact."

POC success criteria (agreed):
- Sustained throughput at 80% of target for 2 business days with no SLO violations.
- Cross-region failover test where EU warm-standby handles >90% of NA traffic within 3 minutes with p95 degradation less than 2x baseline.
- Delivery of security artifacts and signed SLA appendix.

Open items:
- Final reserved GPU counts may adjust after synthetic load tests (scheduled 2026-03-17).
- Procurement wants a two-tier pricing option (commit + burst credits).
- Legal needs confirmation on cross-border trade message storage for EU residency.
